description: This file defines the 'Payment' class, a model representing a payment transaction with associated attributes such as payment type, transaction type, module name, and currency.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: A class modeling a payment with properties for payment type, transaction type, module name, and currency.

methods.name: setPaymentType
methods.description: Sets the payment type for this Payment.

methods.name: setTransactionType
methods.description: Sets the transaction type, defaulting to 'AUTHORIZECAPTURE'.

methods.name: setModuleName
methods.description: Sets the name of the module associated with this payment.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the payment.
